name: Echoing Hearts
source:
"COCK-A-DOODLE-DOO!"

Every day, Kyouko finds herself hiking up the same mountain trail to echo out the cry of the morning. As humans understanding has reached a point where echoes could be rationalized, she finds it's really the only thing worth echoing anymore. However silly a thought, she hopes to someday meet the person behind this mysterious voice.

Echoing Hearts is a visual novel featuring a 14k+ word script filled with cuteness, humor, and heart, set in the world of Gensokyo. Follow Kyouko as she falls for the bird-brained Kutaka, with both girls finding more in common with each other every passing morning.

[from [url=https://minute.itch.io/touhou-echoing-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“公鸡嘟嘟！”

每天，恭子都会爬上同一条山路，以回响早晨的叫声。随着人类的理解已经达到可以合理化回声的地步，她发现这确实是唯一值得回声的东西了。不管这个想法多么愚蠢，她都希望有一天能够见到这个神秘声音背后的人。

《Echoing Hearts》是一部视觉小说，剧本超过14k字，充满可爱、幽默和温馨，以幻想乡的世界为背景。跟随杏子爱上头脑简单的久塔卡，两个女孩每天早上都会发现彼此更多的共同点。

[来自[url=https://minute.itch.io/touhou-echoing-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
